Why Live in Conestoga?

In Weld County, the Conestoga Subdivision offers quiet suburban living with quick access to big-city amenities via Highway 85. With parks, new homes, and a close-knit vibe, Conestoga is one of Ault’s fastest-growing neighborhoods.

Local Amenities:

  • Ault Fire Protection District (less than 1 mile away)
  • ☕ Coffee shops: Lulu's Coffee House, Zoe's Cafe in nearby Greeley
  • Conestoga Community Park & nearby dog-friendly spaces
  • Northern Plains Public Library – 3 minutes away
  • Groceries: Family Dollar, Greeley King Soopers 15 min

Top-Rated Schools

Students attend Highland Elementary, Highland Middle, and Highland High School—all within the Ault-Highland RE-9 district. Known for strong academics and community spirit.

FAQs About Conestoga & Ault, CO

  • Is Conestoga a good place to raise a family?
    Yes! The neighborhood is safe, has great schools, parks, and a strong sense of community.
  • What’s the average home price in Conestoga?
    As of April 2025, the median is $314,000.
  • How close is Conestoga to Greeley or Fort Collins?
    You're 25 minutes from Greeley and about 35 from Fort Collins.
  • What are the schools like?
    Students attend Highland Elementary, Middle, and High School—all well-rated in the RE-9 district.
  • Are there community events in Ault?
    Yes! Don't miss the Fall Festival and International Food Fest.
  • Can I walk to parks and amenities?
    Yes, there are walking trails, a community park, and the fire station is nearby.
  • Who can I talk to about buying or selling in Conestoga?
    Christine Gwinnup is your local expert with decades of experience in Ault.
